title: Prediction Topic Accuracy
dataSources: Forecasts (`prediction:forecast`), resolved outcomes (`prediction:outcome`), personal bets (`bet:personal`), calibration scores (`calibration:score`), Brier scores (`brier:score`).
app: Personal forecasting and calibration — a private prediction journal of dated forecasts about your own life, resolved outcomes, and calibration / Brier scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prediction:outcome
| stats avg(eval(if(result="correct",1,0))) as hit_rate, count as n by topic
| eval hit_pct=round(100*hit_rate,1)
| where n>=3
| sort - hit_pct
description: Breaks your forecasting accuracy down by topic — work, health, relationships, money — to reveal your blind spots.
value: Knowing which subjects you predict well and badly tells you where to trust yourself and where to seek advice.
implementation: Ingest resolved outcomes by topic into `index=personal`; compute accuracy per topic.
visualization: Bar chart of prediction accuracy by topic.
grandmaExplanation: It shows which parts of life you predict well and which you get wrong, revealing your blind spots.
